title: Mad Child Productions stages Anna Ziegler’s ‘Boy’ in November
summary: Mad Child Productions will stage Anna Ziegler’s play “Boy” from November 27 to 29 and December 4 to 6 in Makati City, with actor Cholo Ledesma returning to the production, this time as director.
